item.title: 017 Warmth That Returns
item.description: True warmth is born in care, trust, and quiet companionship. What we give sincerely to others often returns when we need it most.

item.title: 031 Brother Superhero
item.description: True strength is measured not by power, but by the ability to protect without frightening.

item.title: 033 Faithful Guardian
item.description: True guardians do not seek recognition. They simply remain.
